summary.title: Down the Rabbit Hole: RC3 Floor 3
summary.synopsis: The party infiltrates the First House's secret research facility RC3 to retrieve Kharkov's god-killing weapon, only to find it in the grip of a catastrophic "cognitive breakwater" event — a Deep incursion that has suspended researchers from yellow cords and set the installation's architecture reshaping itself in real time. Armed with a dead man's red keycard and an increasingly haunted elevator, they descend floor by floor, looting what they can and trying to reach Floor 5 where all surviving personnel are being evacuated.
key_beats: Lev uses Pinpoint to locate the body tied to the beating heart they carry; it points to a dumpster behind a coffeehouse at 1218 Providence Street in a nicer district of Serengrad.

Lev distracts the coffeehouse staff while Don and Henrik sneak into the alley and find the torso — arms and legs bagged separately — and a red passcard belonging to 'Leonard Fildren,' a name nobody recognizes. The card doesn't match the expected identity of Xander Orozcoca, a blue-clearance Orozcoca Cabal vampire.

Voychek requisitions and gifts Henrik a burlap sack of six quicksilver shield spikes — supernaturally sharp (d8), gildable with other metals — stolen from a Fourth House encampment. Don later crafts them together with warp glass spikes into a super-spike.

Back at the safe house, Divex identifies the heart's container as a modified Cranium Preserver — vampire necromantic tech that keeps a heart beating while the body decays. The party confirms the Trickster's/Liar's Downfall only counteracts illusions, meaning they're safe inside the orb.

Divex uses the Aniriscope on the heart and sees matte black with a flashing red light and faint hairline fractures leaking yellow. An occultism spirit-consultation reveals the 'backdoor into RC3' is Ilkheim — the Deep's city.

The party spends a full day casting Locate Object searching for a blue keycard near RC3 but fails to get any pings. They resolve to go in with the red card and Lev disguised as Leonard, storming the front door.

Lev enters RC3, passes through a water-curtain checkpoint, and descends to Floor 1 (Red clearance) — where klaxons blare warnings of cognitive breakwater, threshold manifestation, architectural restructure, and mnemonic breach; all personnel are ordered to Firebreak Gamma on Floor 5. The red card cannot access Floor 5.

On Floor 1 the party finds Department of Dimensional Correspondence staffed by dead researchers suspended from yellow cords, all mouthing 'adjoining the center of the black sun' — only red cards on the bodies. They then enter the Office of Symbiotic Interactions via a cord-pull that transports them through a lighthouse hotel lobby with four cocktails.

Don, Lev, and Henrik drink cocktails: Don gains cat-eyes and a perception boost; Lev's skin turns blue granting poison resistance and a death-resurrection; Henrik's body locks immovable-rod-style for a minute. In the Symbiotic Interactions lab they find a yellow keycard on a head researcher, a 'Curious Teardrop' intelligent earring (neurotic, chatty, casts Curse of Lost Time), and a Sitzmittel — a fairy-tale multi-legged mimic-like creature — which they capture in its containment unit.

Using the yellow keycard, the party ascends to Floor 3 (Yellow clearance), where the signs point to the Department of Recursive Entities and the Office of Mnemonic Preservation. Session ends as they step out onto the third floor.
locations: RC3 Floor 1 (Red) — Department of Dimensional Correspondence, Office of Symbiotic Interactions, Bureau of Emotional Contagion
RC3 Floor 3 (Yellow) — Department of Recursive Entities, Office of Mnemonic Preservation
items: Yellow keycard (looted from head researcher on Floor 1)
Quicksilver shield spikes x6 (combined with warp glass by Don)
Curious Teardrop (intelligent earring — casts Curse of Lost Time, Pharos Form, or 7th-level Elemental Form; reflects emotion/mental effects)
Sitzmittel (captured fairy-tale creature in containment unit)
Cocktails from the lighthouse lobby (blue: poison resist + resurrection; tiki: perception/cat-eyes; clear: immovable rod effect)
summary.cliffhanger: The party steps out of the elevator onto Floor 3 (Yellow clearance) of RC3, with the facility in chaos from a Deep incursion, facing two ominous departments — Recursive Entities and Mnemonic Preservation — and still floors away from their goal on Floor 5.
